ITEM.PTXT: Based on the vehicle speed signal (CAN communication) input from the skid control computer, the meter computer controls the rotation angle, speed and direction of the pointer with the stepper motor driver circuit to indicate the vehicle speed.
The meter computer performs initialization control that returns the pointer to the zero position each time power is supplied to the combination meter.
